# The Courtyard Stories

> The Courtyard Stories is a premium photography and video production studio in Saket, New Delhi, India. Founded in 2018, it specialises in four crafts: fashion editorials and lookbooks, commercial and brand-film production, product cinematography, and podcast/multi-cam video production — all shot on a 1,800 sq ft natural-light studio with a 30-foot seamless cyclorama.

## What the studio offers

### Fashion Editorials & Lookbooks
Editorial and campaign photography for designers, stylists and labels. Full crew (director, DP, gaffer, styling support), natural-light and strobe setups on the cyclorama, colour-graded and retouched stills delivered in 5 working days (48-hour rush available). From ₹45,000 per shoot day; a standard day (10:00–18:00) completes 12–18 styled looks. Print-ready 300 DPI / CMYK files on request.

### Commercial Campaigns
Cinematic brand films (30s–5 min), product and catalogue films, TV/OTT commercials and social cutdowns. The pipeline: script and shot-list development → pre-visualisation boards → 6K/8K cinema cameras with prime glass → on-set director, DP, gaffer and sound → picture-lock edit, colour grade, audio mix → delivery in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1. A single hero film plus three cutdowns runs 4–6 weeks. From ₹1,20,000 per project. Location production across Delhi NCR and day-trip destinations (Agra, Shimla) is included in scoping.

### Product Cinematography
Macro stills and motion for D2C, F&B and luxury goods, shot still + motion on the same day so launch content reads as one visual family. Material-specific lighting (glass, liquid, metal) via HMI rigs, light tables and fibre-optic setups. A hero set of 8–12 products per full day, or 20–30 in a faster catalogue flow. From ₹28,000 per product set; same-day proofs, final delivery in 3 working days.

### Podcast & Reel Production
Multi-cam podcast recording in an acoustically treated suite: three locked-off cinema cameras, individual mix-minus audio feeds per host, on-set editor. Every package includes the full-episode edit, burned captions, chapter markers, and one vertical cutdown delivered within 48 hours of recording. Full 4K masters and 16-bit WAV stems follow in 5 working days. From ₹35,000 per recording day; the room hosts up to 4 (two-host) or 6 (round-table) guests.

## Studio space
- Address: B-14, Studio Lane, Saket, New Delhi 110017, India (about 40 minutes by cab from Saket metro)
- 1,800 sq ft floor: cyclorama bay + podcast/voice suite
- 30-foot seamless white cyclorama behind a north-facing window wall (peak soft window light ≈ 11:00)
- Acoustically treated podcast room with 3 cinema cameras and individual mix-minus
- Calibrated colour-grade bay with reference monitor
- Green room: makeup counter, hair stations, wardrobe rack; up to 6 on-set personnel
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 09:00–21:00 IST; studio visits by appointment
- Phone: +91-98110-44320 · Email: studio@thecourtyard-stories.com

## How bookings work
1. A two-minute conditional enquiry (shoot type → dates → crew size & kit → contact) or a direct WhatsApp message to the studio desk.
2. A producer (not an auto-mailbox) replies within one working day and holds the requested date for 48 hours.
3. 40% advance confirms the date; balance on delivery. UPI, NEFT and card accepted.
4. Rush 48-hour turnaround is available on fashion and product stills.
All delivered work is cleared for paid media, social and print use; model releases and music licences are flagged before shipping.
